decision.reasoning_trace: In evaluating the product feed for a high-quality Bluetooth speaker, I prioritized sound performance, battery life, and brand reliability. The JBL Charge 5 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_120) and Pulse 4 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_131) represent the premium end of the spectrum with excellent ratings. The DOSS SoundBox Pro+ (prod_bluetooth_speakers_008) is a strong mid-range contender with great bass reviews, while the NOTABRICK (prod_bluetooth_speakers_168) and EWA Mini (prod_bluetooth_speakers_192) offer value and portability respectively. I ultimately chose the JBL Charge 5 because of its industry-leading 4.8 rating, 20-hour battery life, and IP67 waterproof/dustproof rating, which provides the best long-term reliability for outdoor and indoor use compared to the more expensive, aesthetics-focused Pulse 4 or the potentially less durable budget options.
